members.notes: Loves clear blue water, coasts. Doesn't like yoghurt.
Loves mountains, lakes, vintage bars with wood paneling, supper clubs. Fried rice for breakfast. No cheese.
Loves cities, shopping (Brandy Melville etc), steak, potatoes, fish, green beans, oysters, sushi. Likes Starbucks and boba. No sandwiches, eggs, cheese, not much dairy.

philosophy.core: Optimize everything — feel like we made above-average choices across the board
philosophy.spending: Love fancy places but not spending a ton. Think optimized value, not cheapest.
philosophy.discovery: Hidden gems over tourist traps. Elevated everyday experiences.

food.identity: Foodies — love both cheap and expensive food but it must be really good
conditional: Tacos only occasionally — must be street tacos with insanely good tortillas
Chinese only if insanely good — we have good Chinese in Pittsburgh already
avoid: Too rich, buttery, or creamy food
drinks: Great coffee — Blue Bottle tier, cute aesthetic coffee shops

love: Elevated greenery in cities — NYC High Line, SF Salesforce Park, GG Park, Central Park, Millennium Park
Very aesthetic places — SF Ferry Building tier
Water, coasts, clear blue water (dad especially)
Cities with great shopping for teens (daughter)
Vintage/atmospheric bars with character — wood paneling, supper club feel (wife)
Fancy but optimized — elevated experiences without overpaying

dietary.daughter: No cheese, no sandwiches, no eggs, limited dairy
